page.notes: Confervatione (chapter X): printed with a long-s form, read as Confervatione. Essentia, Substantia and Existentia are printed with long-s spellings and are given here in their normal forms. Lines of chapters X and XIII wrap over two printed lines; each is kept as one entry. The oval library stamp at the top and the faint digitiser's watermark at the lower right are not printed text and are left out.
